page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-72-lssd is an arm64-based server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs and 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include any graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance is equipped with 6442 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering high-capacity local storage directly attached to the virtual machine. The underlying arm64 architecture provides a modern instruction set designed for scale-out workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, maintaining consistent execution times.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture combined with a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:4 offers a resource-dense profile for workloads requiring significant local storage capacity. This configuration is suitable for scale-out databases, local caching tiers, data processing pipelines, and general-purpose applications that require high-speed, low-latency local NVMe storage without the overhead of external storage attachments.
